intelligence.essence: The button says "Let's Go" — Shawn's choice, by data, not feelings. The top action words are Get, Start, Try, Join, Discover, Claim, Unlock, Download, Now, Free. Verb plus what you get beats a bare verb; first-person beats second-person 25–90%. Worst are Submit, Continue, Click Here (~2%). "Enter" is on no winning list — it is a door label.
